title: Home promises only what the teams' report holds, and the test runner stops skipping inherited tests
request: The owner: fix Home's 'ranked list' promise and run the full gate.
spec: Home's hand-over to the Lead says what the report will hold (what the data can answer, its limits, who acts next), never a ranked list, a trained model or a score; measured live on Qwen. The test runner splits a slow file into units without losing any test.
plan: state the report's contents in the ask_teams tool result and in both Home prompts
make agent-eval and make harness-eval on the changed prompts
live S1, S8, S10, S11 on Qwen
fix the runner when its split broke test_lead_workspace
run the 30 files whose split changed, on files and PostgreSQL

decisions.decision: Say what the report holds in the tool result as well as the prompt
decisions.why: the model wrote the promise right after the tool answered; the tool's next step is the nearest instruction

decisions.decision: A unit is a real test case only: a class whose bases reach a TestCase in the file or by name; tests inherited from a mixin count
decisions.why: a mixin with a base (_Lead(_Contract)) was split into units that cannot run, and a case whose tests all come from a mixin was skipped

change: dclab_rnd/agents/case_agent.py (ask_teams next and report_holds), prompts case_agent.md and case_agent_think_first.md, tests/run_parallel.py units_of.

findings.defect: Home's model promised 'the ranked list will come back'
findings.cause: nothing told the model what the teams' report holds
findings.fix: the tool result and the prompts say it: what the data can answer and its limits, never a list, a model or a score
findings.test: live S1, S8, S10, S11 on Qwen: no promise in any hand-over; agent eval and harness eval HRN-142 pass

findings.defect: the parallel runner skipped whole test classes when it split a slow file
findings.scenario: test_lead_workspace became slow and was split: 40 units of the mixin _Lead failed to load, and LeadWorkspaceTests and PgLeadWorkspaceTests (all tests inherited) were never run; 30 files split differently once fixed, e.g. FileStoreContract, PostgresTaskAdmissionTests, FileDeliveryTests had been skipped in split runs
findings.cause: units_of took any class with a base as a case and read only a class's own methods
findings.fix: a class is a unit only when it reaches a TestCase; its tests include those inherited from classes in the file
findings.test: the 30 changed files (837 tests) pass on files and PostgreSQL with the new split

measurements.name: live hand-over wording on Qwen (S1, S8, S10, S11)
measurements.gate: no hand-over promises a ranked list, a trained model or a score
measurements.result: 4 of 4 without a promise; 8 of 8 calls with thinking; EUR 0.0024

measurements.name: the 30 re-split files
measurements.gate: all pass on files and PostgreSQL

outcome: The promise is gone live, and every split file now runs all its tests.
lessons: A green gate only says the tests it ran passed: check that a split runs the same tests as the whole file.
Tell the model what a result will hold at the moment it speaks about it, in the tool's answer.
risks: S8 still restates the request ('asked the teams to rank accounts'), which a reader could take as a promise; one run each.
